framework: Autonomous-readiness criteria for SDL instrument interfaces
name: SDL Orchestration Hub API

endpoints.description: All surveyed orchestrators with location, links, integration mechanism and standards.
Criteria C1–C21: tier, default weight, what each checks, how to test it, and the Pass/Partial/Fail rule.
Scoring rules: grade values, tiers, maxima, the sequential decision order and floors, precondition deliverables, RFP evidence pack.
Public instrument scorecards with results computed by score.js.
Deployment archetypes with recommended default integration boundary.
Instrument groups (from the paper's scope statement) with suggested types and tasks, used to tag scorecards.
Learning path and resources for building device connectors (2026 Device Integration Hackathon), plus the paper's advice for connector authors.
Standards comparison: SiLA 2, OPC UA + LADS, typical REST, MCP.
JSON Schema for an instrument evaluation (input to score.js and the web app's Import).
JSON Schema for an orchestrator record.
Snapshot of open submission issues (orchestrators and device evaluations from the issue forms), raw and parsed. Refreshed by the Pages workflow; the site prefers the live GitHub API.
Issue-form parser (UMD). Node: require('./issues.js').parse(issue, { forms, criteria }). Browser: window.SDLIssues.
Scoring engine (UMD). Node: require('./score.js').evaluate(evaluation, { criteria }). Browser: window.SDLScore.
